name: Crossword: No Ads
subtitle: 100% free. No ads.
description:
100% free. No ads. Just daily crosswords.

A minimalist crossword app with one new puzzle each day.

• 3,000 full-size 15 × 15 crosswords
• Newspaper-style grids with 70–82 Across and Down clues
• Pinch to zoom in on the grid
• Automatic progress saves
• Continue unfinished puzzles anytime
• Keep completed puzzles
• Works offline

No account. No subscriptions. No purchases.

A new puzzle unlocks at local midnight. Your puzzle library never repeats.
reviewNotes: No sign-in, payments, ads, tracking, or server connection. Tap New puzzle to start today's crossword. Tap a square to select it; tap again at a crossing to change direction. Use the letter keys, Clues, and Check. Pinch the grid to zoom. Existing mini puzzles remain available with their saved progress. Home lists unfinished and completed puzzles. One new puzzle can be started per local calendar day; returning to any saved puzzle is unlimited. The app includes 3,000 full-size 15×15 newspaper-style crosswords, with symmetric blocks and every letter crossed. The next puzzle ID and start date are preserved in Keychain; progress is stored locally. No data is collected. The privacy/support link opens the system browser.
